summary: Russian forces conducted massive combined strikes across Ukraine including ballistic missile threats from Bryansk and Kursk regions, while Ukrainian drones hit major Tatarstan oil refineries and Moscow. Frontline fighting intensified in Sumy, Kharkiv, Kupyansk, and Zaporizhzhia sectors with Russian advances reported at Vasyutinskoye and Torskoye. Russian missile production exceeded plans by 110-120% in July with 198 ballistic missiles launched, while new Geran-4/5 turbojet drones and Rassvet satellite system deployment accelerate.
key_points: Russian missile production surged 110-120% above plan with July record of 198 ballistic missiles including Iskander-M, S-400, and Zircon. (Source: @eRadarrua/104769)
Ukrainian drones struck Tatarstan's major oil refining cluster hitting TANEKO, TAIF-NK, and Nizhnekamskneftekhim plants, injuring 48 people. (Source: @eRadarrua/104772, @tass_agency/389547)
Russian forces struck Odesa Thermal Power Plant, seven substations, and destroyed Bugrovatoe gas field infrastructure in Sumy region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)
Five civilians killed in artillery shelling of Bugayivka residential area in Kharkiv region's Chuhuiv district. (Source: @UkraineNow/83332)
Russian troops liberated Vasyutinskoye on Kramatorsk front and captured Torskoye on Druzhkovka front per Russian sources. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)
Ballistic missile threats persist from Bryansk and Kursk regions targeting Chernihiv, Kyiv, and northern Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70027, @mon1tor_ua/70024, @mon1tor_ua/70035)
Russian attacks on Danube shipping created virtual blockade affecting over half of Ukraine's agricultural exports. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32316)
Russia deploying Geran-4/5 turbojet drones and Rassvet satellite constellation (292 by 2027, 924 by 2035) to enhance strike capabilities. (Source: @eRadarrua/104769, @UkraineNow/83336)

sections.executive_summary: Russian missile production reached record levels in July with 198 ballistic missiles launched while new turbojet-powered Geran-4/5 drones and Rassvet satellite system deployment accelerate. Ukrainian strikes hit critical Tatarstan energy infrastructure as Russian combined attacks targeted Odesa energy facilities, Sumy gas fields, and Kharkiv residential areas killing five civilians. Frontline advances reported in Kramatorsk and Druzhkovka sectors alongside intensified fighting in Zaporizhzhia and persistent ballistic threats from Bryansk and Kursk regions.

points: Ukrainian drones conducted overnight strikes on Sevastopol and Crimea with 13 drones shot down approaching Moscow, while early morning attacks hit Tatarstan's major oil refining cluster including TANEKO (Tatneft), TAIF-NK, and Nizhnekamskneftekhim (SIBUR) plants. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322, @eRadarrua/104772)
Ukrainian operators employing fiber-optic cable drones to target objects in Slavyansk, demonstrating advanced precision strike capabilities against Russian positions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)
Ukrainian air defense reported shooting down 285 drones during daylight hours (08:00-20:00) across multiple sectors, indicating massive Russian drone offensive. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)

Zelensky stated Western partners oppose Ukrainian ballistic missile production citing Europe's lack of interceptors, while Ukraine cannot mass-produce such weapons without Western assistance. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32311)

Ukrainian bulk carrier attacked by Russian forces while exiting Danube, contributing to virtual blockade of maritime trade handling over 50% of Ukraine's agricultural production. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32316)

Russian missile production exceeded annual plans by 110-120% with July record of 198 ballistic missiles (Iskander-M, S-400, Zircon), Kh-101 at 140% (87 vs 72 planned), Kalibr at 111% (29), while Zircon (33) and Oniks (60) annual quotas completed by early August. (Source: @eRadarrua/104769)

Russian forces struck Odesa Thermal Power Plant and seven regional substations, destroyed Bugrovatoe gas field infrastructure in Sumy region, and hit garage cooperative in Zaporizhzhia overnight. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)

Russian artillery shelled Bugayivka residential sector in Chuhuiv district killing five civilians, while KAB guided bombs struck Sumy civilian infrastructure five times wounding at least five. (Source: @UkraineNow/83332, @UkraineNow/83329)

Russian troops liberated Vasyutinskoye on Kramatorsk front and captured Torskoye on Druzhkovka front, while intensifying fighting in Malaya Tokmachka with advanced reconnaissance groups operating in Orekhov. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)

Russia transitioning to Geran-4 and Geran-5 turbojet drones harder to intercept, integrating Mesh networks for online control, and deploying Rassvet satellite constellation (292 by 2027, 924 by 2035) as Starlink analog. (Source: @eRadarrua/104769, @UkraineNow/83336)

Russian drone strikes destroyed all gas stations in Oposhnyansky community (Poltava region) and attacked industrial enterprise and private housing in Poltava district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32328, @UkraineNow/83329)

Ballistic missile launches from Bryansk and Kursk regions threaten Chernihiv, Kyiv, and northern Ukraine with Iskander-M/S-300 systems on high alert. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70027, @mon1tor_ua/70024, @mon1tor_ua/70035)
On Kupyansk front, fighting continues in Kupyansk-Uzlovaya, Kurilovka, and Kovsharovka areas with persistent positional battles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)
Krasnolimansk sector sees Russian forces repelling Ukrainian attacks near Redkodub while focusing on destroying enemy logistics and supply lines. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)
Kramatorsk front: Russian forces liberated Vasyutinskoye, marking territorial gain in Donetsk region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)
Druzhkovka front: Russian sources report capture of Torskoye, advancing toward Kramatorsk agglomeration. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)
Zaporizhzhia front: Fighting intensified in Malaya Tokmachka with Russian advanced reconnaissance groups operating in Orekhov area. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)
Russian drones targeting civilian vehicles along R-280 highway from Zaporizhzhia region to northern Crimea, disrupting movement. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)

Sumy front: Sever border guard detachment engaged in fighting across Shostka district (Ulanovo, Volnaya Sloboda) and Sumy district (Pisarevka, Maryino, Khrapovshchina, Khoten, south of Ivolzhan). (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)

Belgorod region: Cleanup continued after previous night attack with another civilian body found; two men injured in drone attack on commercial facility, three injured in Shebekino enterprise drone detonation. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)

Kharkiv front: Sever detachment fighting in Kazachya Lopan, Shcherbakovka, Kudievka, Goptovka; Volchansk sector battles in Vasilievka, near Shevchenkovo and Petropavlovka; Velikoburluk direction fighting near Vodyanoye and west of Ustinovka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)
Chernihiv region under ballistic missile threat from Bryansk region with active attack warnings. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70027)
Kyiv faced ballistic missile threat with air raid alerts active, while drone tracks observed from Belgorod region toward Kharkiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70024, @kpszsu/72254)

Multiple reactive drone tracks across Sumy region toward Okhtyrka, Poltava region toward Zinkiv and Reshetylivka-Velyka Bahachka, and Kharkiv region toward Lozova and Nova Vodolaha. (Source: @kpszsu/72224, @kpszsu/72229, @eRadarrua/104773, @kpszsu/72240, @eRadarrua/104777)
Odesa region: Russian strikes hit Thermal Power Plant and seven substations, degrading energy infrastructure. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)

Zaporizhzhia region: Overnight strike on garage cooperative, one civilian killed and four wounded per OVA head; drone attacks on civilian equipment along R-280 highway to Crimea. (Source: @UkraineNow/83329, @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)
Danube River: Russian forces attacked Ukrainian bulk carrier exiting Danube, contributing to virtual maritime trade blockade affecting over 50% of agricultural exports. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32316)
Mykolaiv region: Drone tracks from Kherson region toward Bashtanka and Snigurivka observed. (Source: @kpszsu/72258, @kpszsu/72250)
Dnipropetrovsk region: Reactive drone from Zaporizhzhia toward Kamianske, and drones toward Bozhedarivka/Krynky from south. (Source: @kpszsu/72241, @eRadarrua/104775)
Poltava region: All gas stations in Oposhnyansky community destroyed; industrial enterprise and private housing hit in Poltava district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32328, @UkraineNow/83329)
Moldova: Unknown drone crashed and exploded in Stefan-Voda district causing fire, no casualties, under investigation. (Source: @UkraineNow/83319)

Russian July missile production: 198 ballistic missiles (record), Kh-101 at 140% plan (87), Kalibr at 111% (29), Zircon (33) and Oniks (60) annual norms completed early August; Kinzhal and Kh-32 paused since April. (Source: @eRadarrua/104769)

Russian focus shifted to accurate ballistics and anti-ship Kh-35 (plan doubled), with Geran-4/5 turbojet drones harder for mobile groups to intercept, plus Mesh network integration and Rassvet satellite system testing. (Source: @eRadarrua/104769)
Rassvet satellite constellation deployment accelerating: fragmentary coverage now, 292 satellites planned by 2027, 924 by 2035 for full Starlink-like capability. (Source: @UkraineNow/83336)
Ukrainian air defense shot down 285 drones in single daylight period (08:00-20:00) indicating massive Russian drone offensive scale. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32322)

Persistent ballistic missile threats from Bryansk (Chernihiv, Kyiv) and Kursk (Iskander-M/S-300) regions with repeated launch warnings. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70027, @mon1tor_ua/70024, @mon1tor_ua/70035, @mon1tor_ua/70028, @mon1tor_ua/70029)
Raytheon and Lockheed Martin reluctant to license Patriot interceptors to Ukraine fearing IP theft and potential Ukrainian reverse-engineering for mass production. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32321)
Turkish FM called for Russia-Ukraine mechanism to establish moratorium on Black Sea merchant shipping strikes after Turkish vessels damaged. (Source: @UkraineNow/83317)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian missile production surge and new turbojet drone deployment indicate sustained high-intensity strike capacity through autumn-winter targeting energy infrastructure. The Rassvet satellite constellation will eventually provide Russia with Starlink-like resilient communications and targeting, reducing Ukrainian electronic warfare effectiveness. Ukrainian deep strikes on Tatarstan refineries demonstrate growing asymmetric capability but risk escalatory Russian responses against Ukrainian critical infrastructure. Frontline advances in Kramatorsk/Druzhkovka sectors suggest Russian offensive momentum in Donetsk Oblast despite attrition. Danube blockade and Black Sea shipping threats require urgent international diplomatic response to prevent global food security impacts.
sections.regional_response: Turkey actively seeks Black Sea shipping moratorium after Turkish vessels damaged, positioning itself as mediator. Moldova investigates drone incursion in Stefan-Voda district, highlighting conflict spillover risks. Peru citizens recruited via false promises for Russian war effort reveals Moscow's expanding foreign labor exploitation. Serbia maintains pro-Russia stance despite Zelensky visit, refusing sanctions. Western reluctance to license Patriot missiles and support Ukrainian ballistic missile production reflects strategic caution about technology transfer and escalation management.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian missile production data from intercepted documents shows deliberate prioritization of ballistic and anti-ship missiles over hypersonic Kinzhal/Kh-32, indicating tactical shift toward massed precision strikes. Geran-4/5 turbojet engines and Mesh network integration represent significant UAV capability leap, challenging Ukrainian mobile air defense groups. Rassvet satellite deployment timeline (292 by 2027) suggests Russia investing heavily in space-based C2 resilience. Ukrainian fiber-optic drone use at Slavyansk shows tactical innovation for jam-resistant strikes. Danube shipping attacks confirm Russia's economic warfare strategy targeting Ukrainian export revenue.
